## TRA Timeline

#### Calyxt / Cibus business combination and TRA execution

- 2023-01-17: 8-K announces the Calyxt / Cibus Global merger agreement
- 2023-05-31: Merger consummated; Cibus Global, LLC merges with Calyxt, Inc.; the surviving public registrant is renamed Cibus, Inc.; Tax Receivable Agreement executed and filed as Exhibit 10.3 to the 2023-06-01 8-K

#### Ongoing in-force status with full valuation allowance

- 2026-03-17: FY2025 10-K confirms full valuation allowance against TRA-related deferred tax assets; no balance-sheet TRA liability recognized; contract remains in force

## Explanation

This TRA originated at the May 31, 2023 close of the Calyxt / Cibus Global business combination, which created an Up-C public registrant where one had not previously existed (Calyxt's 2017 IPO had been a non-Up-C structure with no TRA). The contract pays 85% of cash tax savings on Exchange Basis Adjustments (Section 754 step-ups arising when OpCo Units exchange for Class A Common Stock) and on tax attributes acquired in the Blocker Mergers. Cibus has maintained a full valuation allowance against the underlying deferred tax assets, so no TRA liability is recognized on the balance sheet; this is not a termination signal but reflects "tax assets not yet realizable" Up-C accounting. No amendments, restatements, or change-of-control events affecting the TRA have been observed through the FY2025 10-K. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record.
